$comment: The conformance corpus this repository is measured against, pinned by commit.
Why a lock file exists. The pass rate in ROADMAP.md and the corpus:survey gate are
claims about a specific set of files. veraPDF-corpus is fetched from the `staging`
branch, which moves: without a pin, a corpus update and a parser regression are
indistinguishable — the number drops and nobody can say which one did it.
Measured 2026-08-13 against the SHA below: 2881/2907 (99.1%), every pass specimen
parsed. `baselineParsed` is the gate's floor, not a target — see scripts/parse-corpus.mjs.
To move the pin: update `commit`, re-run `npm run corpus:fetch` (it re-fetches when the
recorded commit differs), re-run `npm run corpus:survey`, and update the numbers here in
the SAME commit. A pin bump and a code change must never share a commit — otherwise the
next person cannot tell which one moved the rate.
